preview.settings.address.defaultMessage: Each start gets a free port from {first}–{last} in {variable}. The server must listen on it on localhost: the page is then at {url}.
preview.settings.address.description: A line in Project Settings → Preview: where the dev server must listen. {first} and {last} are port numbers (the range), {variable} is PORT (an environment variable), {url} an address such as http://127.0.0.1:%PORT%/: keep the last two as they are.

preview.settings.badPath.defaultMessage: A page path starts with / and has no spaces or backslashes.
preview.settings.badPath.description: An error under the Page box (Project Settings → Preview): what was typed isn't a page path.

preview.settings.clear.description: A button (Project Settings → Preview): removes the project's preview command.

preview.settings.command.description: A field's label (Project Settings → Preview): the command line that starts the project's development server.

preview.settings.commandPlaceholder.description: The example in the empty Command box (Project Settings → Preview): a command line, keep it as it is.

preview.settings.failed.description: An error's title: saving Project Settings → Preview's values failed.

preview.settings.hmr.defaultMessage: A second port for hot reload
preview.settings.hmr.description: A switch's label (Project Settings → Preview): the server also gets a port of its own for its hot reload socket, in CW_PREVIEW_HMR_PORT.

preview.settings.hmrNote.defaultMessage: In {variable}, for a server whose hot reload socket listens apart.
preview.settings.hmrNote.description: Beside the switch "A second port for hot reload" (Project Settings → Preview). {variable} is CW_PREVIEW_HMR_PORT, an environment variable.

preview.settings.noSuggestion.defaultMessage: No dev, start or preview script in package.json to suggest.
preview.settings.noSuggestion.description: A line under the Command box (Project Settings → Preview): the project's package.json has none of these scripts (keep their names as they are), or there is no package.json.

preview.settings.path.description: A field's label (Project Settings → Preview): the path of the page to open on the server, such as / or /app.

preview.settings.save.description: A button (Project Settings → Preview): saves the preview's command, page and hot reload port.

preview.settings.saved.description: A notification: Project Settings → Preview's values were saved.

preview.settings.suggested.description: A line under the Command box (Project Settings → Preview): Combwork found a script in the project's package.json. {script} is its name (dev, start, preview), {line} its command line, {command} the command Combwork suggests (npm run dev): keep them as they are.

preview.settings.useIt.description: A button beside the suggested command (Project Settings → Preview): puts it in the Command box, unsaved until Save.
